name: dhun_commons
description: A three-party seasonal treasury and field kitchen for Dhun's landscape: private multisig proposals, DHN rewards for node uptime and field work, steward profiles with background and capability review, a whole-wallet assistant that suggests reward-earning work, local-only Ollama menu suggestions with guest-scaled sourcing and cost estimates, zero-waste steps, farm sourcing and a guarded long-life pantry, with live LEZ testnet accounts. Kitchen inference never falls back to a remote provider.
author: Dhun Commons
